question.problem: Let $E=\{1,4,9\}.$ Which of the following is equivalent to ${1}_{E}(9)?$
question.worked_solution:
The indicator function $1[P]$ equals $1$ if the predicate $P$ is true and $0$ if $P$ is false.

$$
1[P]=\{\begin{aligned}1, & \text{if }P\text{ is true}, \\ 0, & \text{if }P\text{ is false}.\end{aligned}
$$

Recall that the indicator function ${1}_{E}(x)$ of a set $E$ equals $1$ if $x\in E$ and $0$ if $x\notin E.$ This can be written using Iverson bracket notation as

$$
{1}_{E}(x)=1[x\in E].
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
{1}_{E}(9)=1[9\in E]=1[9\in \{1,4,9\}].
$$
